resolution: Added the missing /test right-click ADS camera behavior to the no-V8 loader: RMB hold switches from walk Orbit to the native Aim-rig math with shoulder offset, 2.4m distance, 47 degree FOV, wider aim pitch limits, smoothed position/target/FOV transition, and body yaw pinned to camera yaw while aiming. Releasing RMB returns to the walk Orbit clamp. This is committed with the broader no-V8 player camera and animation batch; not marked done, awaiting user verification via tools/rjit game play.
